svg.title: The February 1934 measurement break
svg.desc: Baseline FSI and a diagnostic removing only the January-February 1934 jumps in FX/gold reserves, gold cover and the emission gap, while retaining subsequent movements. The FSI falls by 0.630 points in that month; 0.471 points, or 74.8 percent, come from the three affected reserve variables. The diagnostic is not a causal policy counterfactual.
